ghidra_exception.reason: The current Ghidra C view truncates after an imported printk, while the repaired 224-byte body and all 175 P-Code records remain present. No assembly, relocation, KCFI or Joern gate was weakened.

claim: The candidate preserves the stock function at the offline function level: 224 bytes, 56 AArch64 instructions, 8 relocations, matching KCFI and matching P-Code operation shape, with the host contract passing under ASan/UBSan.
limitations: Android runtime, kernel sysfs integration and NX809J physical hardware behavior remain unverified.
The claim does not establish equivalence of unrelated functions or whole-driver behavior.
The exact assembly remains the behavior authority for this target; the Ghidra C truncation is retained as a documented diagnostic artifact.
